svg.title: Stereo PIV imaging setup components
svg.desc: Stereoscopic particle image velocimetry components: the transparent test section with the seeded measurement plane, the light-sheet optic above it, and two cameras on posts viewing the plane obliquely from upstream and downstream, each with a Scheimpflug adapter between body and lens.
